column3: Close to the Greek; “the kingdom of the heavens” is rendered “the kingdom of heaven.”
Close to the Greek; “had his garment of camel's hair” becomes “was clothed in camel's hair.”
NKJV has “in the Jordan” without “River,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text adds ποταμῷ (“river”).
NKJV has the plural “fruits worthy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the singular “fruit worthy.”
Close to the Greek; “clear” is rendered “thoroughly clean out.”
Close to the Greek; “behold” is rendered “suddenly,” and NKJV supplies “came.”
